name: Pending Reason 29 Code
definition: Standard code to specify the reason why the instruction/event has a pending status.

NPAY.name: No Payment
NPAY.definition: Payment has not been made by issuer.

NSEC.name: Not Delivered
NSEC.definition: Financial instruments have not been delivered by the issuer.

AUTH.name: Sent To Tax Authorities
AUTH.definition: Instruction/event is pending because the reclaim is sent to the tax authorities.
